meta.write: finer box as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. A bigger FFT is not continuation. n is a knob on the box. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B33_finer_readable
lemmas.statement: longer n=32 miss, empty high shells, and the short window are readable together
lemmas.why: T=0.384 > 0.375. Mass above j*+1 stays ~0. n=32 dealias cannot host a fat j=4. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B33a_finer_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: a finer box (n>32) closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: A bigger FFT is not continuation. n is a knob on the box. The working box already cannot host the cascade the slogan wants.

lemmas.name: B33b_fft_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: cashing n=64 after a decaying n=32 path is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: Continuation is an estimate, not a finer mesh. Past the sitting of c=8 the path still decayed. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B33c_n64_not_ns
lemmas.statement: an unrun n=64 box is still an NS a priori
lemmas.why: The field on this box went down. A box you did not run is not the packet. Do not sit a finer FFT as the estimate.

lemmas.name: B33d_finer_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: a finer box is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: n is a knob on the check. A mesh is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. DNS-never-blew-up at a finer n is the same refused slogan.

lemmas.name: B33e_dns_finer_leftover
lemmas.statement: a finer box makes the DNS run an a priori
lemmas.why: The climb leftover is scored (B22e). Leftover close on finer-as-DNS is B23e. Not this FFT. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B33f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring a finer box as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. n is a knob on the box. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8 into the equation. Do not spawn n=64.
